add (autoTMM, no category).text: qBittorrent torrents.add into "/downloads" (automatic management) on qBittorrent at 127.0.0.1: 1 source(s): magnet "Fedora"

add (autoTMM, savepath ignored).text: qBittorrent torrents.add into "/downloads/tv" (automatic management, category "tv"; savepath "/elsewhere" is ignored) on qBittorrent at 127.0.0.1: 1 source(s): magnet "Fedora"; category "tv"

add (download path, share limit action).text: qBittorrent torrents.add into "/b" on qBittorrent at 127.0.0.1: 1 source(s): magnet "Fedora"; downloads in "/tmp/dl", removed with its files when its share limit is reached

add (magnet keys in any case: TR, tr., W.text: qBittorrent torrents.add into "/downloads" (the default save path) on qBittorrent at 127.0.0.1: 1 source(s): magnet "Fedora"; magnet trackers, sources, peers and DHT nodes: http://10.0.0.1, udp://open.example:1337, https://seed.example, peer 10.0.0.2:6881, DHT node router.example:6881

add (manual, relative savepath).text: qBittorrent torrents.add into "/downloads/iso" on qBittorrent at 127.0.0.1: 1 source(s): magnet "Fedora"

editCategory (to implicit).text: qBittorrent torrents.editCategory on category "movies": save path ""; its torrents in automatic management move to "/downloads/movies"

setCategory (clear).text: qBittorrent torrents.setCategory on torrent "Ubuntu 24.04 Desktop": clear the category; torrents in automatic management move to "/downloads"

setCategory (explicit path).text: qBittorrent torrents.setCategory on torrent "Ubuntu 24.04 Desktop": category "movies"; torrents in automatic management move to "/downloads/movies"

setCategory (implicit path).text: qBittorrent torrents.setCategory on torrent "Ubuntu 24.04 Desktop": category "tv"; torrents in automatic management move to "/downloads/tv"

setCategory (reserved characters).text: qBittorrent torrents.setCategory on torrent "Ubuntu 24.04 Desktop": category "tv/odd:name?"; torrents in automatic management move to "/downloads/tv/odd name "

setCategory (subcategory).text: qBittorrent torrents.setCategory on torrent "Ubuntu 24.04 Desktop": category "tv/shows"; torrents in automatic management move to "/downloads/tv/shows"

setCategory (under a parent with its own.text: qBittorrent torrents.setCategory on torrent "Ubuntu 24.04 Desktop": category "films/x"; torrents in automatic management move to "/media/films/x"

setCategory (unknown).text: qBittorrent torrents.setCategory on torrent "Ubuntu 24.04 Desktop": category "nope"; torrents in automatic management move to the path of category "nope", which does not exist

setRule (automatic management, category).text: qBittorrent rss.setRule on new rule "New" on qBittorrent at 127.0.0.1: saves to "/downloads/tv" (automatic management, category "tv"), category "tv", from no feeds; matching articles download without another approval

setRule (save path cleaned, download pat.text: qBittorrent rss.setRule on new rule "New" on qBittorrent at 127.0.0.1: saves to "/srv/iso", downloads in "/tmp/dl", share limit action "Stop", from no feeds; matching articles download without another approval
